scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && tsc --project tsconfig.json && pnpm --recursive typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.test:docker: pnpm sandbox-image:build && pnpm build:packages && BARRACK_DOCKER_TESTS=1 vitest run
scripts.test-database:start: docker run --detach --rm --name barrack-test-database --publish 127.0.0.1:54329:5432 --env POSTGRES_USER=barrack --env POSTGRES_PASSWORD=barrack --env POSTGRES_DB=barrack_test --tmpfs /var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:17.12-alpine && until docker exec barrack-test-database pg_isready --host 127.0.0.1 --username barrack --quiet; do sleep 0.2; done && echo 'Ready. Run: export BARRACK_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://barrack:barrack@127.0.0.1:54329/barrack_test'
